description: I am a front-end developer born in 1999 in Bitola, Macedonia.
I specialize in building modern, responsive web interfaces with React, TypeScript and Three.js, and I build interactive iGaming and animation-based games with PixiJS.

workExperience.description: Developed and optimized interactive iGaming applications and animation-based games using JavaScript and TypeScript, specializing in high-performance game development with PixiJS. Implemented engaging visual effects and smooth gameplay mechanics, while collaborating in an Agile & Scrum environment.
Worked on multiple client-side projects using VueJS, NuxtJS and React. Also worked on projects using WordPress and PHP, and created a custom CMS with Strapi.io and WordPress.

Worked on three projects: two internal initiatives and one client project. Held weekly client presentations with regular updates on project progress, in an Agile environment with daily standups and sprint planning and retrospectives.
Customer care representative for US hospitals. Handled patient calls and scheduled appointments for their visits.
